meta.name: House and garden as surveyed
meta.grid: Site grid. Origin: the outer south-east corner of the rear outshot at ground level, by the back door. +X runs south, away from the back of the house; +Y runs east, towards the road. z = 0 is level 20.00 m on the measured survey.
meta.north_note: Grid north, as a direction in (X, Y). The back of the house faces 20 degrees west of south.
meta.source: Three phone clips (a pan from the lawn and two short walks) reconstructed with COLMAP: 472 frames, 174,000 points. Vertical from brick coursing. Scale, position and height datum from eight control points read off the measured building survey (1:50 plans, 1:100 elevations). Plot boundary and north from the 1:500 block plan.
meta.accuracy: House and shed: a few centimetres (measured survey). Patio and east garden, filmed on foot: about 0.1 to 0.2 m. South and west garden, filmed from one spot: checked against a second viewpoint and good to about half a metre along the line of sight, better across it. Outbuilding: front wall within 0.3 m, the rest assumed. Drive, front garden and everything behind the shed: not surveyed.

features.label: South wall (dark modern brick)
features.notes: Modern dark stretcher-bond brick with a red plinth, behind the big shrub and the bench. Its line is the plot boundary on the block plan, which agrees with the brick coursing seen in the footage (75 mm courses put it 8.9 m from the camera). The top is hidden by the shrubs: height 1.6 to 1.85 m. Its east end was outside the pan, so it stops where the footage stops.

features.label: South wall, west end (old stock brick)
features.notes: Yellow stock brick in Flemish bond with a coping: a 6 ft wall. Position and height triangulated from two clips (top of coping 1.76 m above datum, ground here about 0.08 m below it). Within about 0.3 m.

features.label: West wall (old red brick)
features.notes: Soft red brick, exposed for about 2 m behind the picnic table and ivy-covered either side. Triangulated from two clips (231 points, flat to 0.27 m). It runs about 1.2 m outside the boundary drawn on the 1:500 block plan, which is within that map's tolerance.

features.label: Ivy on the west wall
features.notes: Dense ivy standing about 2.1 m, from the exposed brick to the hazel.

features.label: Fence to the playing field
features.notes: Dark boarded fence seen between the hazel and the outbuilding. Only a glimpse in the footage: its line is the wall's line carried on, and its height is a guess.

features.label: Beech hedge along the road
features.notes: Clipped beech about 1.9 m tall. Its garden face is measured from the walking clip, 9.0 to 9.6 m east of the grid origin; the road side is not seen, so the thickness is assumed. Taller trees stand in it towards the north end.

features.label: Gate posts between the house and the shed
features.notes: Glimpsed at the edge of the pan. Position within a metre or so.

features.label: The house
features.notes: From the measured building survey (1:50 plans, 1:100 elevations and section): main range 8.52 x 5.66 m, rear outshot 4.38 x 4.38 m under a catslide roof that comes down to 0.9 m, ridge 7.62 m, half-hipped at both ends, three chimneys, lean-to WC on the west side. Wall positions are good to a few centimetres. The north (front) and west elevations are from the drawings only; window bars and joinery are indicative.

features.label: Timber shed (mossy roof)
features.notes: Footprint 2.58 x 4.41 m from the measured survey; the gable seen in the footage lands within 12 cm of it. Eaves 1.46 m and ridge 2.38 m from the footage.

features.label: White outbuilding
features.notes: Roughcast walls, black fascia and sheet roof. The front wall, its west corner, the window and the door are triangulated from two clips (rays meet within 5 cm): the front is 13 m from the middle of the lawn and at least 5.9 m long. The east end is hidden behind the shed, and nothing behind the front wall has been filmed: the 6.7 x 5.0 m footprint is an assumption. The block plan draws a 5.0 x 6.7 m building here, the other way round and 2.4 m further east, so one of the two is wrong. Walking round it will settle it.

features.label: Paved patio
features.notes: Old concrete flags in courses, about 0.47, 0.59 and 0.71 m (18, 24 and 28 in). The outer edge is 4.96 m long and 3.85 m from the low wall of the house. Two spot levels on the measured survey put it at 19.99 m.

features.label: Old apple tree
features.notes: Marked "Apple" on the measured survey: trunk 0.40 m across at the base, crown 4.9 m across centred 1.3 m north of the base, because the trunk leans hard towards the house. The first model had put it 0.44 m away from here using the footage alone. Height and branch pattern are indicative.

features.label: Willow (pollarded)
features.notes: Pollarded tree in front of the west wall, cut back hard: one limb sawn at about 4.4 m. Trunk about 0.6 m across. Species not confirmed. Position from the pan and one walking-clip sighting: within about a metre along the line from the middle of the lawn.

features.label: Hazel (multi-stem)
features.notes: Tall coppice in front of the ivy at the north end of the west wall; its base is hidden by the brush pile, so within about a metre.

features.label: Big old shrub with the hose
features.notes: Pale multi-stemmed shrub leaning out over the bench and tables, between the lawn and the south wall.

features.label: Small twisted tree
features.notes: Stands just in front of the outbuilding window.

features.label: Evergreen shrub
features.notes: At the east end of the south border.

features.label: Shrubs along the south wall
features.notes: Only just in frame. Shown as part of the border; treat as a placeholder.

features.label: Yellow-leaved coppice by the south wall
features.notes: Tall twiggy growth in front of the dark wall behind the log rounds. Species not identified.

features.label: Shrub in the east lawn
features.notes: Bushy deciduous shrub in a ring of bare soil, 1.9 m across and 1.75 m tall. Measured from the walking clip.

features.label: Grey-leaved shrub
features.notes: Large silvery evergreen at the edge of the lawn; the drive is behind it.

features.label: Yellow-leaved shrub
features.notes: Seen from a distance at the north end of the east garden.

features.label: Conifers in the north-east corner
features.notes: Dark evergreens 8 to 10 m tall, seen over the vegetable plots. Position within a couple of metres.

features.label: Sage bed under the apple tree
features.notes: Overgrown bed around the pale tree: a big sage, low evergreens, twiggy stems, foxglove rosettes. Plant positions are approximate.

features.label: Sedum bed
features.notes: The bed beside the viewpoint. The pan started and ended here so only its edges were filmed; the far side of it is assumed.

features.label: Vegetable plot
features.notes: Bare dug plots with canes, seen across the lawn from 12 m. Outline within about half a metre.

features.label: Picnic table
features.notes: A long one: 2.1 m. Its two ends were sighted from both clips.

features.label: Split log stack
features.notes: Position from points seen in both clips.

features.label: Football
features.notes: Sighted from both clips: it lies at the foot of the stock wall.

features.label: Garden bench
features.notes: Size checked against the footage with the calibrated camera.

features.label: Folding table
features.notes: Top 0.66 m above the grass, measured.

features.label: Pots along the house wall
features.notes: A dozen or so assorted pots and a trough stand along the low wall; individual pots are indicative.

features.label: Large terracotta pot
features.notes: Stands on the grass just off the west edge of the patio. Sighted from two clips.

features.label: Green glazed pot with grass
features.notes: At the south-east corner of the patio. Triangulated from three frames: the rays meet within 3 cm.

features.label: Big tree stump
features.notes: A very large stump: 1.6 m across the cut, root flares spreading to about 3 m, 0.55 m high. Measured from the walking clip.

features.label: Neighbour's house (west)
features.notes: Brick house seen over the west wall behind the pollarded tree. Footprint from the block plan (its nearest corner is 4.3 m beyond the wall); heights from the footage. Massing only.

features.notes: Outer south-east corner of the rear outshot at ground level. X runs south from here, Y runs east. Tape measurements from this corner are the easiest way to improve the model.

features.label: To film 1: Front garden and house front
features.notes: Walk a slow loop of the front garden with the camera on the house, then turn your back to the house and walk it again looking outwards. Keep the ground in frame.

features.label: To film 2: West side: house, shed, outbuilding
features.notes: Walk the gap between the house and the shed and on round the back of the shed and the outbuilding. All four sides of both, with corners in shot.

features.label: To film 3: Drive, entrance and south-east corner
features.notes: From the road entrance walk in along the drive, then along the inside of the south wall to the bench.

features.label: To film 4: South and west garden on foot
features.notes: This part was filmed from one spot, so its distances are the weakest in the model. Walk two loops round it: one hugging the walls looking in, one in the middle looking out.

features.label: To film 5: Outbuilding
features.notes: Outside: every wall, square on and at each corner, with the ground line visible. Inside: stand in each corner in turn and film the opposite corner, floor to ceiling.

features.label: To film 6: Shed
features.notes: The same as the outbuilding. Leave the door open and film from outside to inside in one go, so the two join up.

features.label: To film 7: Inside the house
features.notes: Room by room, slowly, from each corner; walk through every doorway with the camera running so the rooms link together. Ground floor, then stairs, then upstairs.

features.label: To film 8: Roof and chimneys
features.notes: From the far corners of the garden and from the road, a few still photos of each roof slope and chimney, zoomed in.
